query: How does TSMC define its HPC platform revenue category
normalized: category define hpc platform revenue tsmc

output.content:
TSMC defines High-Performance Computing (HPC) as a **product/application platform**, rather than a reporting category limited to AI chips or data centers; its HPC platform includes **PCs, tablets, game consoles, servers, base stations, and related applications**. [[1]] 

The category therefore encompasses the semiconductor content used in those end markets—such as **CPUs, GPUs, NPUs, AI accelerators and related ASICs**—and is supported by advanced process technologies and 3D packaging. [[1]] 

In practical product terms, TSMC identifies HPC products as including **AI GPUs and ASICs, PC CPUs, consumer GPUs, FPGAs, server processors, and high-speed networking chips**, serving uses including **5G/6G infrastructure, AI, cloud, and enterprise data centers**. [[1]]
